# Weather Comparator

> A free, bilingual application for comparing daily temperatures across multiple years for a
> selected city and period.

Weather Comparator lets users:

- Compare maximum or minimum daily temperatures across years.
- Display the 1991–2020 climate normal.
- Highlight heat waves, severe heat, cold waves, and severe cold.
- Export chart data as PNG or CSV and share the selected comparison through its URL.

Weather and geocoding data come from the public Open-Meteo APIs. Reverse geocoding uses
Nominatim. No account or API key is required.

The interface is available in English and French.

## Resources

- [Weather Comparator application](/): Open the interactive weather comparison dashboard.
- [Source code and documentation](https://github.com/tblt-gr/weather-comparator): Review the
  project source, setup instructions, and feature documentation.
- [Open-Meteo Historical Weather API](https://open-meteo.com/en/docs/historical-weather-api):
  Learn about the historical weather data used by the application.
